title: Langflow CVE-2026-33017 Exploited Within 20 Hours of CISA KEV Listing

CVE-2026-33017.evidence: Langflow CVE-2026-33017 Exploited Within 20 Hours of CISA KEV Listing Sysdig's Threat Research Team documented an attacker exploiting the Langflow RCE vulnerability within 20 hours of its addition to the CISA KEV catalog.
